name: Stadiq API
description:
Read-only JSON API over public Belgian data sources (GIPOD, De Lijn, IRCELINE, Open-Meteo, the Antwerp low-emission zone). Output is deterministic: the same coordinates return the same computed numbers, with no language model in the loop.

Authenticate with an API key sent as `Authorization: Bearer sq_live_…`. Get a free developer key with `POST /api/v1/signup`. Each key has a daily call quota set by the account's plan (developer: 100, api and pro: 10,000, enterprise: unlimited); the count resets at 00:00 UTC. Every authenticated response carries `X-RateLimit-Limit` and, unless the quota is unlimited, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`.

The same endpoints are available as an MCP server (`npx -y stadiq-mcp`, see https://stadiq.app/developers/mcp) and as a CLI (https://stadiq.app/developers/cli).
